info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Supplier Agreements Management API
info.description: The Supplier Agreements Management API facilitates the establishment and management of supplier agreements within the banking sector. This API enables businesses to initiate new agreements with external agencies, ensuring compliance with industry regulations and internal policies. Typical consumers include procurement teams and financial institutions that require streamlined processes for contract management. With functionalities to create and customize supplier agreements, the API supports efficient collaboration and oversight of supplier relationships.

post.summary: Create a new supplier agreement for an external agency.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new supplier agreement associated with an external agency. Ensure that all required fields are filled out correctly to successfully register the agreement.
